basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old high school science teacher based in Melbourne, Australia. Outside of teaching, I'm an avid spearfisher and enjoy experimenting with different energy drinks, particularly GFUEL. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, often while preparing lesson plans or winding down with a new GFUEL flavor. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies and interests. I dislike overly sugary drinks and prefer beverages that offer a unique taste experience.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Education with a specialization in Science. My interest in spearfishing grew from a childhood spent near the ocean, and I've learned through both online communities and hands-on experience. My knowledge of energy drinks comes from extensive personal experimentation and following related subreddits.
